title: Remove the full native matrix bank and reduce complete multiplier storage over 3,500-fold
body:
This construction removes the full invertible low-matrix stock from the 480/264 general multiplier. At its first certified six-stage entrance the ordinary supplier runs its native word with **zero matrix rows**. At wider inputs it keeps one representative per lower-unitriangular orbit and executes the omitted row operations on the payload. A new Fourier schedule also shrinks the wide working field that dominates complete-product storage. The proposed complete **κ = 0.00387992803556** is preserved for arbitrary signed binary operands. [Complete construction](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/README.md) · [Resource proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/NUMERICAL-STORAGE.md) · [Stage and entrance proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/STAGED-CARRIERS.md) · [Receipts](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/EVIDENCE.json)

| Complete resource | [PR #7914](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7914) | New construction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Occupied backing at the same input, including I/O | At least 21,840 pT bits | Less than 6.2 pT bits from the first certified six-stage input onwards. The ratio exceeds **3,520**. |
| Occupied bits per significant operand bit in this range | At least 524,160 | Less than 298 |
| Strong sufficient log₂ p for all six stages inside a true mixing source | 3,840,000,000,000,000 | **355,763,540,965,264** |
| Largest binary rank | 2^240000000000000 | 2^236800000000000, with five smaller earlier ranks |
| Fixed program envelope, log₂ J | 4,800,000,000,000,000,000 | 4,736,000,000,000,000,000 |

Here p = 6 ceil(log₂ n) for an operand of n significant bits and T is the padded tensor size. A sufficient new input length is 2^ceil(2^355763540965264 / 6) bits. The old sixth-stage guard actually requires log₂ e ≥ 2,881,869,654,258,596 for e ≤ p. The lower threshold is therefore a change to execution. The recurring clock has the same form S + O(n(1 + log n)^(1−κ)) with an explicit rank envelope C* J^100. The private per-geometry producer has its own bound 2^(2^20 (s+1)^2), where s = ceil(log₂(p+2)). The absolute primitive constants and a practical crossover remain unknown. The complex rank remains M = 2^3300000000. [Native clock and physical calls](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/BINARY.md) · [Earlier numerical caller and setup](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/46783fbbfc219a3faffbea76f60a2810b85ab75a/research/native-stock-activation/INTEGRATION.md)

There is also an absolute first-entrance comparison. Over every canonical input at the first specified public precision p* = 2^355763540965264 + 2, the entire new machine occupies fewer than 2^(p*) bits. One old native slab would already exceed this bound with just a single bit of payload per required low matrix. This uses an explicit historical tape budget, independent of the unknown recurring coefficient. [First-entrance proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/FIRST-PEAK.md) · [All subsequent inputs and nonzero radix tags](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/ACTIVATED-STORAGE.md) · [Kernel-checked active-owner count](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/lean/ActiveForest.lean) · [Uniform numerical tail](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/lean/UniformSpace.lean)

The same-order receiver handles arbitrary, independently weighted head and tail records. A quotient chart removes a factor 3^(uN(N−1)/2) from true stock at identical rank N and ternary height u. Variable unit scaling, exposed carries, the low radix sort, previous calls, inverse moves, padding and suspended ancestors all have physical instructions and charges. In a matched 139,968-record native body the total traversal fell from 3,017,776,176 to 284,414,976 bytes, including seeks. This finite measurement has its own scope. [Actual receiver](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/receiver.py) · [Compensated chart and movement proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/QUOTIENT-ROUTE.md) · [Matched tape experiment](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/check_integration.py)

The transformed field now completes one normalized Fourier mean on a disjoint pack before opening the next. Its working precision goes from at least 5,460p to less than 1.001p throughout the connected range. The raw allowance of an eighth public grid step preserves both independent source-size factors, the opposite transform, and strict rounding of every unscaled coefficient. The signed tape diagnostic returned −345,550,037,539 and the five expected coefficients after 138 physical rank-two CRT exchanges. It uses explicit (3,5) geometry. At physically available input lengths the public selector uses the finite multiplier. The powered production ranks have a written all-size construction and cannot be timed on this machine. [Signed tape entry and schedule](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/multiplier.py) · [Verification and limitations](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/VERIFICATION.md)

On the complete finite Fourier product, a separate file meter compared 136 old working bits with 72 new working bits at the same 48 public bits. Total file traversal fell from 13,716,909,553 to 8,089,368,893 bytes and peak opened data files fell from 4,550 to 2,886 bytes. Both returned the same signed result. The meter excludes scalar objects and private compiler tables. [Full-product file meter](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/measure_product.py)

The local and exported Python checks need Python 3.12. The formal replay needs Lean 4.34.1 and the pinned mathlib. Run from the repository root.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triangular-native-supplier
python3 -I -B research/triangular-native-supplier/verify_formal.py
```

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/triangular-native-supplier outcome=completed
PASS_TRIANGULAR_KERNEL 11 modules 64 axiom reports ['Classical.choice', 'Quot.sound', 'propext']
```

Lean verifies the new selector-to-carried-product implication under the stated estimates for each generated gate. The only axioms in the 64 inspected reports are propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound. The implementation binding, local compiler estimates, fixed-head movement, peak memory and growing-family price use written proofs. Independent scientific review remains open. [Central gate theorem](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/lean/GatePacks.lean) · [Same-order identities](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/lean/SameOrder.lean) · [Rational price checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/lean/CarrierStages.lean) · [Source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/9585c1fa2ed5f2316ac09e04b357cb720badfcb8/research/triangular-native-supplier/SOURCES.json)

The complete registered runner and all eight commands in a separate read-only, Git-free export passed at the submitted revision. The export needed zero external package inputs. One earlier concurrent local replay exceeded a command timeout. The fresh registered rerun completed within its declared limits. Both file meters reproduced the exact transfer totals. Three additional signed products on the true square side 9 checked all nine coefficients against independent arithmetic in both implementations. The public controller at these finite input lengths uses its finite branch. [Reproduction and results](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/7940#discussioncomment-19791194)

The canonical [hosted planning job](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/44878664852/job/136768904944) failed before selecting this package. Its only failing assertion requires the current selected command in an older navigation guide. The exact failure reproduced on four unchanged files from canonical main, including the test, guide and selected record. Hosted package replay was skipped.
